title: Lion cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dancing lion cub -->
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 66 Q84 60 82 48 Q80 44 76 48 Q78 56 70 62" fill="#E8A030" stroke="#F5C860" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="46" r="4" fill="#C87020"/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <rect x="60" y="66" width="10" height="18" rx="5" fill="#D4901A"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="86" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#C87020"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="58" rx="20" ry="16" fill="#F0B830"/>
  <!-- front leg (dancing up) -->
  <path d="M38 60 Q30 50 26 40" stroke="#D4901A" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="38" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#C87020"/>
  <!-- other front leg -->
  <path d="M40 68 Q36 78 34 84" stroke="#D4901A" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="86" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#C87020"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="36" r="20" fill="#C87020"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="36" r="15" fill="#E8A030"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="22" r="6" fill="#E8A030"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="22" r="3" fill="#F5A0A0"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="6" fill="#E8A030"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="22" r="3" fill="#F5A0A0"/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="36" r="13" fill="#FFD060"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="33" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#5A3010"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#5A3010"/>
  <!-- sparkle eyes -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="33" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="33" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="42" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FFE8A0"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d="M36 41 L40 41 L38 43 Z" fill="#C06020"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M35 44 Q38 47 41 44" stroke="#C06020" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="40" r="2" fill="#F5A0A0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="47" cy="40" r="2" fill="#F5A0A0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill="#7CE0E0">
    <ellipse cx="18" cy="18" rx="3" ry="2.5"/>
    <rect x="20" y="8" width="1.5" height="10" fill="#7CE0E0"/>
    <path d="M20 8 Q25 7 24 11" stroke="#7CE0E0" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#E080E0">
    <ellipse cx="76" cy="22" rx="2.5" ry="2"/>
    <rect x="78" y="13" width="1.2" height="9" fill="#E080E0"/>
    <circle cx="76" cy="22" r="2.5" fill="#E080E0"/>
  </g>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="25" ry="4" fill="#4A3080" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
